GREETINGS:
WHEREAS, a Commission of Inquiry was appointed by me by Warrant dated January 14, 2019; in pursuance of theprovisions of Section 2 of the Commissions of Inquiry Act (Chapter 393),

AND WHEREAS, Pasdunkorale Arachchige Pematilaka Esquire, Retired Auditor General and Lalith R. de SilvaEsquire, retired Secretary to Ministry, who are the members of the said Commission of Inquiry, have resigned theiroffices;
AND WHEREAS, the need to fill the vacancies thus caused has been identified;

NOW THEREFORE, I, Maithripala Sirisena, President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, do inpursuance of the provisions of Section 3 of the Commissions of Inquiry Act, by these presents, appoint W.K.K. KumarasiriEsquire, retired Secretary to Ministry and M.P. Dharmawardana Esquire, retired Deputy Auditor General to beCommissioners of the Commission of Inquiry constituted in terms of the Warrant above referred to reposing great trustand confidence in their prudence, ability and fidelity.
Given at Colombo under the Seal of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on this 12th day of March,Two Thousand and Nineteen.
By order of His Excellency,
UDAYA R. SENEVIRATNE, Secretary to the President.
